name: 06488 · Southbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06488 (Southbury) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06488 (Southbury) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06488 (Southbury) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).
